items.baselineSource: Playlist storage is waiting for the Room v28 integration. Existing Room v27 search and music-pool actions remain available; playlist changes are not saved yet.
items.currentSource: Playlist storage is unavailable right now. You can still browse your music library, but playlist changes cannot be saved until storage becomes available.
items.reason: Room v28 exists; repository == null implies unavailable storage, not pending schema integration.
